links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAFPRS patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability of facial plastic and reconstructive surgery patient education materials (FKGL, GFI, FKRE)
links.effect: Original PEMs mean FKGL 10.7, GFI 13.48, FKRE 50.8; AI-translated PEMs mean FKGL 8.41, GFI 10.62, FKRE 64.43 (p < 0.001)
links.tradeoff: AI-translated PEMs still did not reach the 6th-grade target (mean FKGL 8.41); authors specify physician supervision is needed.
links.quote: With physician supervision, AI platforms can improve the readability of PEMs for common FPRS procedures.

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompts for patient education materials
